sloka: अदुष्टस्य हि सम्त्यागः सत्पथे निरतस्य च ।निर्दहे दपि शक्रस्य द्युतिम् धर्मनिरोधनात् ॥२-३६-२९॥
transliteration: aduṣṭasya hi samtyāgaḥ satpathe niratasya ca ।nirdahe dapi śakrasya dyutim dharmanirodhanāt ॥2-36-29॥

translations.english: The act of banishment of an innocent one walking the righteous path is like destroying the brilliance of Indra by restraining his righteousness.
